premises.text: Salon and other service owners need credible vetted sub-renters; word-of-mouth and Craigslist are ineffective and drive costly turnover
premises.evidence_span: finding sub-renters in a niche vertical remains incredibly inefficient. The only resources are word of mouth and Craigslist

premises.text: Service professionals face geographic lease limits and operational stress from high renter turnover
premises.evidence_span: service coverage limitations due to a lease's geography. And number two, the operational stress resulting from high renter, sub-renter turnover

premises.text: A marketplace lets owners list spaces and sub-renters find flexible hourly-to-monthly vetted rentals across industries
premises.evidence_span: Introducing Renly, a marketplace for renters and sub-renters

premises.text: Supply-side focus across beauty and expanding verticals drives network effects and retention
premises.evidence_span: we decided to focus on the supply side because it was the most challenging to scale

premises.text: Being industry-agnostic across the service industry, not niche competitors, is key to long-term success
premises.evidence_span: being industry agnostic is the key to our long-term success

premises.text: Renly Circle lets consumers and pros discover, book, manage, pay, and find space for services in one platform
premises.evidence_span: as a consumer, can discover, book, Manage, pay, or provide any service you want. No more jumping from Yelp to Google Calendar to Square

value.text: Maximize usage of existing service space and give sub-renters flexible freedom
value.evidence_span: Our mission at Renly is to maximize the usage of existing space

secondary_value.text: Sub-renters gain freedom through flexibility across cities and rental periods
secondary_value.evidence_span: We also offer sub-renters freedom through flexibility
